Rae (docs): Quick heads-up: migration guide still has several examples using `function.call` and the old response envelope. CI for the SDK flagged failing snippets. Can we coordinate a small follow-up?
Tom (eng): I can update the JS example. Our SDK now uses `executeAction` with `action`/`args`. Minimal change.
Ivy (devex): I'll patch Python and add a note in the sidebar about guardrails. Can you post the canonical response shape we should show?
Tom (eng): Canonical response: `{ "status": "ok", "result": { "id": "evt_123" }, "error": null }` — `result` required when status is ok, `error` optional.
Rae (docs): Great. I'll update the schema block to mark `result` required and add the guardrail: "Treat `error` as the canonical failure indicator." Also need to fix a broken anchor linking to `#response-shape`  looks like it was renamed.
sys-link-bot: check-link(https://docs.redwood.ai/migrate#response-shape) -> 404. Suggest anchor: #response-shape--guardrails
Ivy (devex): Adding a small pytest snippet and run linkcheck locally after edits.
Tom (eng): If you want, I'll add a tiny Jest test snippet asserting `res.result.id` so future doc drift gets caught in CI.
Rae (docs): I'll open PR #1330 with JS/Python snippets, schema tweak, and anchor fix. Ping me for review and I'll merge once linkcheck + CI pass.
Ivy (devex): Running local linkcheck now, will report if anything else pops.
Tom (eng): LGTM; happy to help land test snippet if needed.
Rae (docs): Thanks everyone — will drop PR link when ready.
